description: Four additional intermediate profiles per wing, with a constant shoulder attachment

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent wing drawing for an eight-profile robin flight animation. Input 1 style reference: warm painterly brown/gold cartoon, dark clean outlines. Input 2 EXACT same wing at raised extreme. Input 3 EXACT same wing at lowered extreme. Preserve the wing's identity, rounded tiny shoulder joint, individual primary lengths, secondary feather sizes and warm golden/brown palette across this intermediate. Subject is a RIGHT-FACING bird. Output ONE wing only, transparent background, generous margins, no body, text or ground shadow. Compact brown feather attachment at root, not large oval cap or white fluff. Perspective-shaded upper arm and layered feathers give volume. Primary request: FOREGROUND NEAR wing: visible outer upper surface. Halfway between fully raised and horizontal in DOWNSTROKE. Shoulder root LOWER RIGHT. Curved leading edge reaches UP AND LEFT to longest primary tips UPPER LEFT. Trailing fan spreads LEFT and DOWN behind leading edge. Open articulated wing tilted diagonally up-left, broad fan. Same number, length and ordering of primary feathers as reference 2. No change to anatomical wing proportions.
